body.text: Shipping is ₩ 3,000 anywhere in Korea. Orders placed by 3 pm ship in 2–3 business days, not counting weekends and holidays. Remote and island areas cost extra.

You can return a piece within 3 days of delivery. Return shipping is on you. Trying it on is fine, but pieces worn, washed or altered after delivery can't be returned. Every piece is one of one, so we refund instead of exchanging.
Vintage pieces show their age. Every product page lists the condition and shows the wear in the photos. Wear shown there isn't a defect, so check it before you buy.
